name: Volumetric Path Tracing with MIS and Surface Lighting
definition: A path tracing algorithm that handles multiple monochromatic homogeneous volumes with absorption and multiple scattering, using both phase function sampling and next event estimation (NEE), and including surface lighting via the full rendering equation.
summary: Volumetric Path Tracing with MIS and Surface Lighting extends volumetric path tracing to handle multiple scattering and heterogeneous media by integrating surface lighting via the full rendering equation and using multiple importance sampling to balance direct and indirect contributions.
